note: Luminos energy ramp + cross-mode consistency. Layer moved out of chartWrap up to chart-area so signal coloring shows in all three modes (Price, Tool-only, Compose) — previously was hidden in tool-only because chartWrap is display:none there. Added a continuous gravity-spring energy ramp on top of the existing direction-tier sizing per Opus's chair-test reading of bars 120 and 136 on NVDA 1D. IPS-near-zero = spring at rest = move about to start. IPS-deeply-non-zero = spring loaded = move about to end. Now both sprites grow and brighten continuously with gravity distance (ATR-normalized 0 to 2.5 cap) so the chart feels calm when price is near gravity and tense when price has stretched away. Direction-tier (temperature strength) still drives base size and color. Energy stacks additively. Strong buy far from gravity = large + bright + green. Neutral signal far from gravity = large + bright + gold. Near gravity = small + dim regardless of direction.
